create_span_masked_dataset: create a SpanMaskedTokensDataset wrapper for T5-style denoising with configurable noise density and span length
generate_random_spans_noise_mask: generate a boolean noise mask with random spans of masked tokens for a given sequence length
create_sentinel_ids: create sentinel IDs for masked token spans where start indices are replaced with unique sentinel values
filter_input_ids: filter input token IDs by replacing masked spans with sentinel tokens and removing consecutive masked tokens
collate_samples: collate a list of source-target samples into a mini-batch tensor dict sorted by descending source length
